scope: Legacy shared-rule compatibility; not a structured Agent full-game claim

adjudication_fallbacks.reason: Only module-declared completion flags may be committed
Combat checks, costs and results must be settled by combat tools
An item cannot be granted from an unknown source

limitations: Secret/unknown-clue checks follow the harness text probes; this is not a general proof of narrative consistency
The harness checks the ending callback, not character rewards; actual human-mode rewards and separate saves were verified in the human mainline and lifecycle E2E
Account balances, credentials, raw provider headers and real user saves are deliberately not included
